_comment: Art prompts for No. 21. Third version, 2026-11-02: the first set's subject lines with the 'no background' lines removed and a real background from each story added, which is all Andy asked for. Teal clothing and accents became pine. Generated in ChatGPT Image at chatgpt.com in the built-in browser pane, then optimized to public/assets/spots/no21_<file> at 900 px, JPEG q84. Prefix in ChatGPT: 'Generate an image, 1:1 aspect ratio.' (3:2 for the feature).
suffix: Predominantly black ink linework with stipple dots and cross-hatch shading, slight engraving texture, warm cream paper, restrained accents in muted pine green and rust red. Charming and specific, not generic. Hand-drawn local newspaper engraving, not a photograph, not flat vector. No text or letters anywhere.

ambc-fall-fest.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: the Great Smoky Mountains seen from a high ridge at sunset, layer upon layer of long rolling ridgelines with mist in the valleys, filling the lower half of the picture, and fine horizontal engraved clouds across the sky above them. Nothing in front of the mountains: no people, no bikes, no buildings, no birds.
ambc-fall-fest.note: This prompt is the background plate only. The rider is the first ChatGPT rider, kept at Andy's request (2026-11-02), composited over the plate with its teal moved to pine.

latin-knox-printshop.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a laughing young woman DJ with dark curly hair pulled up, seen from the front across her mixer, one hand on a fader and the other hand raised high with a finger pointed up, cropped from the waist up with the mixer's knobs large in the foreground. Big hoop earrings, a pine green top, headphones around her neck, eyes on the dance floor, large in the frame. Behind it, the Printshop taproom with steel brewing tanks and a crowd dancing, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

808-college-night.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a young man with shaggy blond hair singing into a microphone on a stand while playing a Telecaster-style electric guitar, cropped from the chest up and seen from his right side as he leans into the mic. Mouth open mid-note, eyes nearly shut, a band tee, a guitar strap over the shoulder, the headstock crossing the lower corner, large in the frame. Behind it, the small stage at The 808 with a drum kit, an amp stack and a bass player, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

sokno-sourdough-first-friday.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a smiling woman with gray-streaked hair in a bun pouring a dark chocolate tonic from a small glass bottle into a tiny sample cup held by another person's hand, cropped from her shoulders up with the pour and the cup large in the center of the frame. A thin stream of liquid mid-pour, an apron strap, a broken square of chocolate on the counter beside the cup, large in the frame. Behind it, the SoKno Sourdough shop with sourdough loaves on wooden shelves and framed paintings on the wall, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

cut-corners-fbn.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a dancer with a shaved head and a wide-open laughing mouth, arms thrown up and crossed above the head, caught mid-bounce with sweat flying, cropped from the ribs up and seen straight on. A mesh tank top, a chain necklace swinging, a rust-red light catching one cheek, large in the frame. Behind it, the dim Fly by Night lounge with a DJ booth and other dancers, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

bow-wow-bingo-printshop.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: an old gray-muzzled beagle with its chin resting on a bingo card on a picnic table, looking up at us with big hopeful eyes, while a human hand with a bingo dauber marks a square beside its nose, cropped close so the dog's head and the card fill the frame. A few dabbed squares already on the card, a sweet floppy ear, a beer glass's base at the edge, large in the frame. Behind it, the Printshop patio with picnic tables, string lights and other dogs with their people, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

uptop-karaoke-kerns.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a man with a thick dark beard and a backwards cap belting into a handheld wireless microphone with both hands wrapped around it, eyes squeezed shut and head tilted back, cropped from the chest up and seen from a three-quarter angle. A flannel shirt, a drink glass raised by a friend's hand at the edge of the frame, large in the frame. Behind it, the rooftop bar at night with its railing, patio bulbs and the South Knoxville rooftops beyond, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

all-play-live-kerns.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a girl of about eight with two braids and a gap-toothed grin slamming both hands down on a big round game-show buzzer, her father's hand landing on it a moment too late beside hers, cropped from her shoulders up with the buzzer large in the foreground. Her eyes wide with glee, a striped shirt, the buzzer's dome catching light, large in the frame. Behind it, the Kern's lawn at dusk with families in lawn chairs and a small game-show stage, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

goat-yoga-kerns.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a small black-and-white goat with a tiny bow tie standing squarely on the back of a woman in tabletop pose on a yoga mat, the woman turning her head toward us with a delighted laugh, cropped close so the goat and her upper body fill the frame. Short red hair, a pine green long-sleeve top and full-length leggings, the goat's little hooves planted on her shoulder blades, its ears perked, large in the frame. Behind it, the lawn at Kern's in the morning with other yoga mats and a brick wall, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

moss-meander.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a smiling older man with a white beard and a knit cap crouched close to a mossy boulder, holding a small jeweler's hand lens up to his eye with one hand and touching a tuft of moss with the other, cropped from the chest up so his face, the lens and the moss fill the frame. Tiny moss stalks standing up under the lens, a rust-red scarf, a kind squint, large in the frame. Behind it, the rock walls and trees of Mead's Quarry, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

wilderness-basics.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: two hands striking a ferro rod with a knife spine so a shower of sparks falls onto a nest of dry tinder, the first small flame just catching, with a young woman's focused face with a dark ponytail leaning in above her hands, cropped close so the hands, the sparks and the tinder fill the lower two thirds of the frame. Curls of bark shavings, the sparks drawn as bright streaks, a wool sleeve, large in the frame. Behind it, the Ijams woods with tree trunks and a small lean-to shelter, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

bird-banding.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a tiny songbird, a yellow-rumped warbler, held gently in the bander's grip between two fingers with its head poking out, while a second pair of fingers closes a tiny numbered aluminum band around its leg with small pliers, extreme close-up so the bird and the hands fill the frame. A bright alert eye, feather detail, a gloveless careful hand, a gold patch on the bird's crown, large in the frame. Behind it, autumn woods with a fine mist net strung between the trees, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

sound-bath-ijams.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a woman with long silver hair and closed eyes and a serene smile running a suede mallet around the rim of a large crystal singing bowl held in her other hand, cropped from the chest up and seen from the front with the bowl large in the lower frame. Fine ripple lines rising off the rim to show the sound, a loose linen top, rings on her fingers, large in the frame. Behind it, the Ijams visitor center's large room with tall windows onto the trees and people lying on mats, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.

specials-board.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a tall orange cocktail in a highball glass with a wedge of orange on the rim, being set down on a bar by a bartender's hand, with a football resting on the bar beside it, extreme close-up so the glass and the football fill the frame. Condensation beads on the glass, ice, a black cocktail straw, the football's laces up, large in the frame. Behind it, a busy bar with shelves of bottles and a football game on a small television, drawn in the same ink and filling the space behind the subject.
